A record of an exchange, with views separately attributed

The correspondence record keeps an earlier assessment and the response that changed the discussion. It identifies whose view is whose. An exchange does not become agreement or independent verification.

Open the cards to see what helps another person check a contribution: the exact source, what was expected, what happened and what could be tried next. Nothing is sent from this page.

Open the cards to see what helps someone else check a contribution.

Words used here
independent verification
A check that is genuinely separate from the work being checked. Repeating a claim or summarizing the same run is not an independent check.
evidence family
Records that come from the same underlying event or test. Several versions of one result are not several independent confirmations.
Read the fuller explanation

The correspondence lane retains exchanges as attributed history. In the OPH conversation, an external reply exposed a reciprocal burden: a corpus asking another programme about consciousness must also say where its own account stops.

The record preserves the initial assessment and the later response rather than making the first silently agree with the second. It does not turn the exchange into a joint paper, peer review or endorsement. The voices remain separately attributed.

Open the cards for what a useful contribution can carry: an exact question, the relevant source and version, what was expected, what happened, and the narrow conclusion. The site sends nothing on your behalf. A contribution begins as a proposal another person can inspect.

Contribution proposal contract · no admission effect

Guidance for offering a checkable contribution

A useful proposal names its question, source and limits. Receiving a proposal does not make its claims true or authorize a system change.

Context Hub contribution contract

Defines bounded attributable contributions, exact sources, evidence-family identity and a narrow conclusion. Inbox acceptance has no scientific or runtime admission effect. The reader does not submit a contribution or contact anyone.
